title: client.hello
description: First client message on /ws/sessions/{id}: protocol version, capabilities and the client clock reading used for clock sync.

protocol_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR; the backend refuses a different MAJOR.

stt.description: The client's preferred STT mode; the backend chooses in hello.ack.

stt_provider.description: Id of the client's own recognizer, e.g. web-speech or android-speech.

audio_format.description: Present only when the client can stream audio for server-side STT.

client_time_ms.description: Client clock in Unix epoch milliseconds when the message was sent.
